page_claims.claim: The guide locates additions and removals at or above the soil-system boundary and distinguishes the soil-system states below that boundary.
The nitrogen-cycle schematic separates mineral NH4-N, adsorbed NH4-N, NH3, NO3-N, plant and organic pools; it does not identify a dry nonaqueous surface residual-NH4 store.

The transport equation defines liquid concentration plus solid-phase soil contents, while the guide separately defines an artificial reservoir above the compartment division and a ponding-layer solute balance for surface runoff.
CONHTOP is explicitly the NH4-N concentration in a virtual top layer used for additions, distinct from CONH for soil-moisture compartments 0-NL.
WYAD=0 sends inorganic additions to an additional artificial top compartment, and FRVO is specified as the volatilization fraction of NH4-N for the addition event.
Subsequent addition-event records explicitly label FRVO(x) as the fraction of volatilization of NH4-N of the addition.
